scopeDecisions.recommendation: Use behavioral conditions rather than a raw API-method denominator; each declared transaction surface must map to exactly one condition.
Keep query execution inside a transaction here, following the FS-QUERY-INDEX Q4d decision; ordinary query semantics stay with FS-QUERY-INDEX.
Keep transaction commit-to-listener notification ordering as a shared acceptance row with FS-LISTEN-SDK, but count the transaction outcome here and callback delivery there.
Keep transaction-specific resource and timeout limits here; generic document and request limits remain with FS-DATA-WRITE.

Use the sandbox conformance-harness process with clean-context corpus/runner review, two recordings and one JSONL ledger line per run. The old single-run O8 manifest is preparation material only; do not import O7/O8 Gate or reservation tooling. A fresh owner go-ahead remains necessary under the current production-send hold.
Retain historical fireemu-35fe6 recordings as immutable reference only; require sandbox evidence or an explicit owner decision before calling any historical-only condition VERIFIED.
Keep SDK-driven retry distinct from backend retry-token semantics. Do not exclude it on the strength of REST or gRPC observations.

preparedCampaign.cleanup: Roll back every issued token, conditionally remove the five owned documents, and read back typed absence; record unknown resources for recovery.
preparedCampaign.coverageLimit: The three finished-token rows cover only part of failed-commit-and-rollback. The 13-case campaign does not close that full condition or any other transaction condition by itself.

productionPlan.unestimatedReason: The 190-request arithmetic covers only the prepared 13-case expiry/retry campaign. Every other acceptance condition, including the remaining failed-commit behavior and historical-reference replay, needs a finite sandbox corpus, request cap, cost estimate and cleanup plan before permission.
